title: City Manager
key_finding: The City Manager page says the manager oversees day-to-day city operations, implements City Council policies, and manages the annual budget, confirming Homestead is a live municipal government.

title: Police Explorers
key_finding: The official police site says the Police Explorers program falls under the City of Homestead Police Department and lists Homestead Police Department headquarters and contact information at 45 Northwest 1st Avenue.

title: Special Call Meeting Police Chief Swearing In Ceremony Agenda, January 3 2025
key_finding: The official city agenda documents the swearing-in of Mario Knapp as Police Chief on January 3, 2025 and references the Homestead Police Honor Guard.

title: 2024 Annual Report
key_finding: The 2024 annual report says the Police Department accomplished projects and initiatives during 2024 and lists multiple police-related operating and capital actions.

title: Adopted Budget Book for FY25 (Numbers Only) Updated 02-2025
key_finding: The adopted FY2025 budget book includes active Police Department operating lines, police public-records lines, and police pension funding, confirming that Homestead still funds a city police function.

title: 2022 Annual Report
key_finding: The 2022 annual report says the Police Department processed 15,422 incident/offense and crash reports and completed 561 public-records requests, showing a maintained local police records surface.

title: 2023 Annual Report
key_finding: The 2023 annual report says the Police Department processed 13,036 incident/offense and crash reports, completed 190 public-records requests, and deployed ProPhonix as a replacement for CAD, records management, and report writing.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
